_about: Setup facts the Law of Root (2025-10-13) relies on but doesn't print: which factions have militant setup cards (the Law: 'red name with sword', A.8.2) and each faction's setup order letter (the Law: 'In setup order (A, B, C, etc.)', 5.1.7, printed on the faction boards). Supplied by the project owner. Not official rule text; the site labels them as the owner's. Reach values are NOT here: they come from the Law's own table (5.2).

setup_letters.note: Setup letters follow the order of the factions in the Law (chapters 6 to 18): A for the Marquise de Cat through M for the Knaves of the Deepwood. Owner decision 2026-11-11.

setup_cards._note: Owner, 2026-11-11: 'militant factions have high reach, and insurgents have low reach.'
